bullets: US futures bounce ~2% Monday after S&P 500's 7th straight down day hit a correction; Nasdaq 100 had its worst week in 6+ years on AI-capex fears.
Europe posted its worst week since April 2025 (Stoxx 600 -5.8%) as the AI de-rating spread from Wall Street; Asia mixed, Kospi pared a 6% drop.
Oil steadied after pulling back from recent highs: Brent ~$92.57, WTI ~$83.04, after briefly nearing $80, pressuring E&P names sector-wide this month.
Treasury yields eased (2Y 4.61%, 10Y ~4.94%) on risk-off flows; Bitcoin fell below $60k, driving BlackRock's IBIT ETF to record outflows.
